mechanism: Own RTD shared representation; not Q-FT reproduction
features: Original raw21 only;17numeric4nominal; immutable architecture from original design
train_boundary: Feature encoding/scalers/vocab and RTD donors fit only own90percent inner training;10percent inner labels for checkpoint only; outer data rows skipped before SAT parser reads them. Outer features are queries only. No test covariates or external data.
outer_splits: Exact hash-frozen R68/v12 fivefold and threefold fixtures; no regeneration/selection. Threefold only if fivefold complete and gates pass.
arms: same initialization RTD5epochs then reset optimizer and supervised20epochs

optimizer.precision: bfloat16 autocast;float32 BCE logits and parameters;TF32disabled

schedule: Separate CosineAnnealingLR per phase,T_max=5or20,eta_min=1e-5,step after each completed epoch. No earlystop.
epoch_randomness: Seed init+10000+epoch0;pretrain add1000. Independent CUDA generators for order(+100000) and corruption(+200000); reset supervised dropout seed each epoch identically across arms.
corruption: Original15percent per-cell same-column donors; actual-changed targets, selected same values negatives. No clean side features. Donors only inner training.
checkpoint: RTDfinalepoch5. Each arm20fixedsupervisedepochs; best inner validation logloss with clip1e-7; first epoch wins exact tie. Never choose using outer AUC. Retain best weights plus final resumable epoch state.

final_scoring.labels: All completed-fivefold pairs required before target labels are accessed for OOF evaluation; likewise3fold
final_scoring.probabilities: Sigmoid(bfloat16-forward float32 classifier logits) saved float32; positive labelTrue. Model.eval,512rowbatches.
final_scoring.mechanism_effect: Raw RTD AUC minus same-architecture scratch AUC with paired DeLong and corrected-fold statistics, reported separately.
final_scoring.complementarity: Fixed RTD blend versus v12; also fixed RTD blend versus scratch blend to measure added blend utility of pretraining.
final_scoring.admission: Unchanged original design: paired95percent lower>0 AND corrected-resampled-t one-sidedalpha.025lower>0 for RTDblend-v12 AND RTDblend-scratchblend. Full5fold then full3fold. Standalone raw effect descriptive, no additional selected gate.

persistence: Atomic per-arm best+resume, per-epoch progress. Completed arms and pairs reused after exact hashes; incomplete epoch may be replayed, completed fits never retrained. Single-controller advisory lock. No user files deleted.
limitations: Official labels repeatedly reused;95percent intervals conditional on fixed predictions and do not include adaptive history.
Threefold replication is not untouched data.
This small architecture and5epoch RTD do not establish any universal RTD result.
